spec.rawSql:
select
SUBSTRING_INDEX(it.name, ' - ', 1) as name,
MAX(CASE WHEN it.name LIKE '% - ONUs Autorizadas' THEN hu.value END) AS Autorizadas,
MAX(CASE WHEN it.name LIKE '% - ONUs Online' THEN hu.value END) AS Onlines,
MAX(CASE WHEN it.name LIKE '% - ONUs Offline' THEN hu.value END) AS Offlines,
MAX(CASE WHEN it.name LIKE '% - LOS (Fibra)' THEN hu.value END) AS LOS,
MAX(CASE WHEN it.name LIKE '% - LOSi' THEN hu.value END) AS LOSi,
MAX(CASE WHEN it.name LIKE '% - LOF' THEN hu.value END) AS LOF,
MAX(CASE WHEN it.name LIKE '% - DyingGasp%' THEN hu.value END) AS DyingGasp,
DATE_FORMAT(CONVERT_TZ(FROM_UNIXTIME(MAX(hu.clock)), '+03:00', '+03:00'), '%d-%m-%Y %H:%i:%s') AS ultima_verificacao
from items it
left join (select itemid, max(clock) as max_clock from history_uint group by itemid) as max_hu on it.itemid = max_hu.itemid
left join history_uint hu on hu.itemid = max_hu.itemid and hu.clock = max_hu.max_clock
inner join hosts ht on ht.hostid = it.hostid
where it.flags in (0,4) and it.status = 0 and ht.status = 0 and ht.host in ('$host')
and it.name LIKE 'PON %'
and (it.name LIKE '% - ONUs Autorizadas'
  OR it.name LIKE '% - ONUs Online'
  OR it.name LIKE '% - ONUs Offline'
  OR it.name LIKE '% - LOS (Fibra)'
  OR it.name LIKE '% - LOSi'
  OR it.name LIKE '% - LOF'
  OR it.name LIKE '% - DyingGasp%')
group by SUBSTRING_INDEX(it.name, ' - ', 1)
order by name;

SELECT
    SUBSTRING_INDEX(i.name, ':', 1)                                               AS placa,
    MAX(CASE WHEN i.name LIKE '%Uso de CPU%'      THEN hu.value END)              AS cpu,
    MAX(CASE WHEN i.name LIKE '%Uso de Mem%'      THEN hu.value END)              AS memoria,
    MAX(CASE WHEN i.name LIKE '%Status Operac%'   THEN hu.value END)              AS status,
    DATE_FORMAT(FROM_UNIXTIME(MAX(hu.clock)), '%d-%m-%Y %H:%i:%s')                AS ultima_verificacao
FROM items i
JOIN hosts h ON h.hostid = i.hostid
JOIN history_uint hu ON hu.itemid = i.itemid
WHERE i.flags  = 4
  AND i.status = 0
  AND h.status = 0
  AND h.host   = '$host'
  AND i.key_   LIKE 'netstream.zte.card.%'
  AND hu.clock = (
        SELECT MAX(clock) FROM history_uint
        WHERE itemid = i.itemid AND clock > UNIX_TIMESTAMP() - 3600
  )
GROUP BY placa
ORDER BY placa;

SELECT
  sub.host,
  sub.interface,
  sub.bitsin,
  sub.bitsout,
  sub.status,
  sub.speed,
  sub.usoin,
  sub.usoout,
  sub.rxpower,
  sub.txpower,
  sub.distancia,
  sub.limiterx,
  CASE
    WHEN sub.rxpower IS NULL THEN NULL
    WHEN sub.is_xgei = 1 AND (sub.rxpower < -9.00 OR sub.rxpower > 0.00) THEN 'anormal'
    WHEN sub.is_xgei = 0 AND (sub.rxpower < -11.00 OR sub.rxpower > -1.00) THEN 'anormal'
  END AS staturx,
  sub.ultverificacao
FROM (
  SELECT
    ht.name AS host,
    SUBSTRING_INDEX(it.name, ': ', 1) AS interface,
    MAX(CASE WHEN it.name LIKE '%Trafego de Entrada%' THEN h.value END) AS bitsin,
    MAX(CASE WHEN it.name LIKE '%Trafego de Saida%'   THEN h.value END) AS bitsout,
    MAX(CASE WHEN it.name LIKE '%Status Operacional%'  THEN h.value END) AS status,
    MAX(CASE WHEN it.name LIKE '%Velocidade da Porta%' THEN h.value END) AS speed,
    MAX(CASE WHEN it.name LIKE '%Trafego de Entrada%' THEN h.value END)
      / NULLIF(MAX(CASE WHEN it.name LIKE '%Velocidade da Porta%' THEN h.value END), 0) * 100 AS usoin,
    MAX(CASE WHEN it.name LIKE '%Trafego de Saida%' THEN h.value END)
      / NULLIF(MAX(CASE WHEN it.name LIKE '%Velocidade da Porta%' THEN h.value END), 0) * 100 AS usoout,
    MAX(CASE WHEN it.name LIKE '%Sinal RX%' THEN h.value END) AS rxpower,
    MAX(CASE WHEN it.name LIKE '%Sinal TX%' THEN h.value END) AS txpower,
    NULL AS distancia,
    MAX(CASE WHEN it.name LIKE '%xgei%'  THEN '0.00 a -9.00'
             WHEN it.name LIKE '% gei_%' THEN '-1.00 a -11.00'
        END) AS limiterx,
    MAX(CASE WHEN it.name LIKE '%xgei%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS is_xgei,
    MAX(DATE_FORMAT(CONVERT_TZ(FROM_UNIXTIME(h.clock), '+00:00', '+00:00'), '%d-%m-%Y %H:%i:%s')) AS ultverificacao
  FROM items it
  INNER JOIN hosts ht ON ht.hostid = it.hostid AND ht.name IN ('$host') AND ht.status = 0
  LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT itemid, MAX(clock) AS max_clock
    FROM history
    WHERE clock > UNIX_TIMESTAMP() - 7200
    GROUP BY itemid
  ) AS max_h ON it.itemid = max_h.itemid
  LEFT JOIN history h ON h.itemid = max_h.itemid AND h.clock = max_h.max_clock
  INNER JOIN items_applications ia2 ON ia2.itemid = it.itemid
  INNER JOIN applications ap ON ap.applicationid = ia2.applicationid AND ap.name = 'Uplink / LAN OLT'
  WHERE it.flags IN (0, 4)
    AND it.status = 0
    AND (
      it.name LIKE '%Trafego%'
      OR it.name LIKE '%Status Operacional%'
      OR it.name LIKE '%Velocidade da Porta%'
      OR it.name LIKE '%Erros%'
      OR it.name LIKE '%Drops%'
      OR it.name LIKE '%Sinal RX%'
      OR it.name LIKE '%Sinal TX%'
    )
  GROUP BY interface, host
) sub
ORDER BY sub.interface;
